reason: The README clearly describes a DeepSeek Harness plugin that provides an agent-driven, shared real browser for navigating pages, extracting content, interacting with forms, managing sessions, taking screenshots, and downloading files.

summaries.zh: 为 DeepSeek Harness 提供可由智能体驱动并可与用户共享的真实浏览器，用于网页浏览、内容提取和页面操作。
summaries.en: Provides DeepSeek Harness with a shared real browser that agents can drive for web navigation, content extraction, and page interaction.

capabilities: Opens and navigates HTTP(S) web pages
Inspects and extracts page content in multiple formats
Interacts with pages through clicks, typing, form filling, and page JavaScript execution
Captures screenshots and manages browser tabs and sessions
Downloads files using the active browser session
Exports and restores browser cookies for session persistence
Detects CAPTCHA and other human-verification challenges
Records and replays browser operations
Writes downloaded files and screenshots to local paths
